payload.posture: Read Genesis 43:1–14 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states renewed hunger forces the unresolved demand into view; Judah pledges himself and Israel entrusts the sons to God Almighty. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Joseph's story.
